source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Melee attacks whose Strength exceeds the target's Toughness get −1 to their **wound rolls** against an **ADEPTUS CUSTODES** unit of yours, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**, while it is in range of an **[objective](vsdata:core-rule/objectives)**.

**Favoured Ka’tah: Kaptaris**: when you select Kaptaris from [Martial Ka'tah](vsdata:ability/adeptus-custodes.martial-katah) for a readied unit, you may also make an enemy unit **engaged** with it take a **battle-shock roll** at −1. Each enemy unit can be chosen for this only once per phase.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 296 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
